name: automated-security-helper
description: Runs the ASH CLI on your workspace and surfaces its SARIF findings as editor diagnostics.

ash.executablePath.markdownDescription:
Path to the `ash` executable. Empty means resolve `ash` from `PATH`. Set this when ASH is installed in a virtualenv that is not on the PATH of the window.

Machine-scoped on purpose: this names a program that gets executed, so a cloned repository must not be able to set it from its own `.vscode/settings.json`. Same reason `python.defaultInterpreterPath` and `eslint.runtime` are machine-scoped.

ash.outputDirectory.markdownDescription: Directory ASH writes results to, relative to the workspace folder, and required to stay inside it. Matches the CLI default so `ash scan` run from a terminal and run from here agree. An absolute path, or a relative one that escapes the folder, is refused with an error rather than silently rebased.

ash.scanTimeoutSeconds.markdownDescription:
Seconds to wait for `ash scan` before stopping it. `0` waits indefinitely.

A timeout exists because an `ash` that hangs would otherwise leave the progress notification up forever with nothing in the log. The scan is also cancellable from that notification.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
